svg.text: Pakistan Operational Risk Intelligence Platform: Architecture
Sources → Extraction → Parsing and Validation → PostgreSQL 15 → Evidence engines → Read-only API → Responsive dashboard. Evidence-first: it abstains instead of guessing.
DAG paused, fails loudly if run
source = task fails, no partial write
Fixed tools; no SQL / file / shell
Never feed a status or score
PMD Weather · PDMA Rainfall · PDMA Rivers
Design system: tokens, one Plotly template
Extract → Parse → Validate → Load → (optional S3) · retries · callbacks · catchup=False · max_active_runs=1 · Gold, risk engine and evaluations run on demand
• Never fabricate: missing = NULL / n/a, never 0
• Every record loaded, quarantined or loudly rejected
• risk_score NULL is not low risk; score_v2 abstains
• Read-only API and agent; no autonomous writes
• No PostGIS; geometry stored as GeoJSON jsonb
Python 3.11 · Apache Airflow 2.9.3 · PostgreSQL 15 · FastAPI · Streamlit 1.59 · Plotly 6.9 · pandas 3.0 · pdfplumber / camelot / PyMuPDF · scikit-learn
Docker Compose · GitHub Actions · boto3 / S3 (optional) · Databricks / Delta (scaffold) · Terraform (scaffold) · pytest · Ruff

Snapshot as of 2026-10-08. Sources: docs/architecture/FINAL_SYSTEM_STATUS.md, GEOGRAPHY_COVERAGE_STATUS.md, RISK_SCORE_V2_STATUS.md, AIRFLOW_OPERATIONS.md. Counts are point-in-time and change as pipelines run.
